assets.source: Existing MakeHuman Community CC0 adult anatomy
assets.modifications: Two Catmull-Clark subdivisions; blended arm posing, clothing/skin/boot vertex colors, 1.88m standing height, flat ground contact

assets.mapping: Closest authored triangle UV transfer after the existing two-level subdivision and closed head crop
assets.sourceAuthor: MakeHuman asset authors: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius and Jonas Hauquier

body_derivation: Original continuous anatomical field: level feline spine, scapulae, ribcage, abdominal tuck, forward knees and rear hocks, four pads and individual toes. Matte triplanar short coat and surface-rooted combed neck fibres. Not a scanned or AI-image asset.
portrait_derivation: Cropped MakeHuman adult male anatomy, two subdivision passes, closed neck plane; authored diffuse skin texture transferred from the original UV triangles. Blank expression retained.
authoring: scripts/prepare-beast.py, scripts/prepare-falconer.py; reviewed local MakeHuman body.npz; native birds, fur/mane, moor, coast and arch in src/world.
interpretation: A connected literary interpretation: storm coast, broken court and tide, then the poem's desert vision and a masonry threshold. Original kinematic four-beat gait and banked/flapping bird flight, not a full physical simulation or archaeological reconstruction.
